description: Fallback-policy ingress matrix, instance leg pinned EXPLICITLY to missing-or-no-match. Identical catalog to ingress-matrix-policy-default; the pair exists so the corpus records that explicitly configuring the default and leaving it unset are the same thing, checked on BOTH failure reasons rather than only one.

Items.Sparse.commentary: Only ONE and OTHER declared, though Russian also selects FEW and MANY. Reaching MANY throws inside getInternal, which getResult classifies as RESOLUTION_FAILURE.
